title: Inzwi Rokusimba
intro: Munhu uyu anoyeukwa neuchenjeri hwakadzama nenhungamiro, achipa mazano asingaperi. Mashoko avo anoratidza hutsvene uye kukosha kwekuziva makomborero nemiedzo inobva kuna Mwari. Fungidzira hunhu hwemweya uyu unoremekedzwa.
clues: Ndakanga ndisiri muporofita, asi uchenjeri hwangu hunogara husingaperi muMagwaro Matsvene.
Zano rangu kumwana wangu rakasimbisa kutenda Allah uye kudzivisa shirk.
Ndakadzidzisa nezvekukosha kwekunamata, kuraira zvakanaka, uye kurambidza zvakaipa.
Ndakanyevera nezvekuzvikudza uye kufamba nekuzvikudza panyika.
Zita rangu rakapihwa chitsauko chose muQuran, richisimbisa dzidziso dzangu.
Zano rangu raisanganisira kushivirira mumatambudziko, nekuti zvechokwadi, izvozvo zvinobva kune zvinhu zvakasimba kupfuura zvese.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
